Hi! I’m Jose Luis Villagomez III, an undergraduate studying Electrical Engineering at University of California, Santa Barbara. I’m passionate about Team Leadership, Design Engineering, and turning ideas into practical, well-designed projects.

Right now, I’m exploring Autonomous Racing Vechile and building my skills in Lidar racing algorathims and product management. Outside the classroom, you can usually find me with Los Ingenieros, UCSB student Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers chapter, as I am the Chairmen of the organization.

Take a look at my recent work on the **Projects** page, or feel free to reach out—I’d love to connect!
